conversion: render-native.cjs adapted from first-beat-clarity-v6. Area-averaged luminance with ordered 2x2 band dither. Arrival unchanged: threshold 96 and +/-40 band. HOME regional thresholds: pressure habitat 60, ship 90, other/background 120, +/-35 dither band. Ship luminance 75% block mean plus 25% block peak to preserve thin curved underside and porthole rims; no source image change. Return ship x30..67 y17..42, habitat x87..127 y10..39. Lights ship x2..76 y10..49, habitat x73..127 y21..41. 4x nearest-neighbor. Native values only 0 or 255. Readability prioritized over dither reduction.
